ruleDefinitions.name: ETW Logging Disabled In .NET Processes - Sysmon Registry
ruleDefinitions.description: Potential adversaries stopping ETW providers recording loaded .NET assemblies. Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\\\\.NETFramework\\\\ETWEnabled$") AND Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000000\)") OR ((registry_path = RGX("\\\\COMPlus\\_ETWEnabled$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\COMPlus\\_ETWFlags$")) AND (Details = 0 OR Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000000\)")))
